We all know the importance of Indian forces  in ensuring out national security. 
But there has been a fortunate instances when a common man’s intelligence has saved hundreds of life. This is that one story.

India Gate which is a symbol of nation’s pride was once under the target of terrorists. 
How the special forces and a common man came together and saved the lives of hundreds of civilian is a story to be heard. 
Had there been a little bit of ignorance, it would have been a black day in the Indian history. 
With limited clues, how our forces navigated and located the building under target is no easy feat.
Lets hear this story and be aware of the dedication that our forces work with to ensure the security if our nation
